question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 3.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**whereupon**" means immediately after which. (जिसके बाद)
 
• The context describes Dicken's immediate action after seeing Nicole through the telescope.
 
• The other options: "**wherein**," "**whereas**," and "**when**" do not fit as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** In a moment Nicole swam into his field of vision. Whereupon__ he disappeared into his house and came out with a megaphone.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Wherein (जिसमें)**: means in which.
 
• **Whereas (जबकि)**: means in contrast or comparison with the fact that.
 
• **When (जब)**: means at what time.
